description: Use this when the user needs output or failure and billing details from an existing Freebeat task. Call after get_task_status returns completed, failed, or action_required. Failed or paused tasks return failure and billing even without final media. Song-driven videos from generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, and generate_lyric_video, plus effects, singing, and lip-sync tasks, return result.video_url and usually result.cover_url; music tasks return result.audio_url. If the task is still pending or running, this tool returns TASK_NOT_COMPLETED. If the task failed, this tool surfaces the backend failure. For Open RPC image/video batches, get result URLs from get_task_status instead. Does not start generation.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by a generation tool

name: get_task_result

message.description: A human-readable summary of the completed task result.

result.description: The structured output payload for the completed task. Video tasks return video_url; music tasks return audio_url. Both may include cover_url and other metadata.

music_id.description: Pass this generated music reference directly to a song-driven video tool.

status.description: The normalized task status; unrecognized upstream values become unknown.

success.description: Whether the task result was retrieved successfully.

task_type.description: The task category returned by Freebeat.
